name: specboard
description: The specboard marketplace — a visualised spec-driven development board built from your own codebase.

plugins.name: specboard
plugins.description: A visualised spec-driven development board. Every screen is two ends — its requirements, and the E2E tests that prove them against the real app. Drift is derived, never tracked: a requirement is proven only while a passing test tags it with an assertion that would fail without it; contradictions across requirements are surfaced for you to adjudicate.
